messages:
mari: FYI customer INC-4834 reporting swapped tool outputs when we fan out two tools in parallel. They see cite_check output ending up in the summary.
ben: Which endpoint + payload? any correlation ids in their request or our logs?
mari: POST /v1/chat/completions (hosted). model=redwood-xxl. Tools: ["summarize", "cite_check"], payload set tool_calls.parallel = true. Customer included header x-request-id: 9f1a3c. They attached a minimal payload.
ben: Can you paste the runtime logs around that request? suspect call_id collision / association bug. :eyes: 
mari: pasted logs below. note both tool events share same call_id.
```
[2026-02-18T15:22:31Z] req=9f1a3c tools.dispatch: started parallel calls to summarize(...) and cite_check(...)
[2026-02-18T15:22:31Z] tool.summarize: call_id=abcd1234 result_id=r1
[2026-02-18T15:22:31Z] tool.cite_check: call_id=abcd1234 result_id=r2
[2026-02-18T15:22:31Z] runtime: associated result r2 to call abcd1234
[2026-02-18T15:22:31Z] runtime: associated result r1 to call abcd1234
```
lia: If both tools get the same call_id, dispatcher is likely giving IDs scoped only by request and not by tool. We should namespace by tool name or include a per-tool seq.
ben: digging in dispatcher code now. Looks like we used a request-local counter that was incremented in a hot path but isn't namespaced. Two goroutines scheduled at same tick can grab same value.
mari: customer reproduction steps? they want a quick curl to validate fix.
ben: Minimal repro curl (use a small fast-return tool for both to make timing tight):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'x-request-id: repro-987' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-xxl","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<doc>"}],"tools":[{"name":"summarize","schema":{}},{"name":"cite_check","schema":{}}],"tool_calls":{"parallel":true}}'
```
ben: repro steps for internal testing:
1) send the payload above (tools that respond in <10ms)
2) fire 10 concurrent requests with same x-request-id header
3) watch runtime logs for duplicate call_id values and mismatched associations
lia: temporary mitigations: disable parallel tool calls via customer feature flag or set serialized dispatch for dedicated customers until patch lands. Also add a quick middleware to append tool name to call_id.
ops-sre: rolling out a patch to dispatcher to generate call_id as `req-{reqid}-{tool}-{seq}`. will deploy to us-east-1 staging now, then prod.
alex: eng-platform owns private packaging, I'll raise the PR and link it. PR: https://git.internal/rdw/pull/4822
ben: I'll add unit + concurrency stress tests asserting uniqueness and correct mapping when 1000 tool calls happen concurrently per request.
lia: add telemetry alert too: emit metric `tool_result_mismatch` when runtime associates a result_id to a different tool_name than the one that created it. label with customer_id, route, model.
mari: timeline for customer: patch rolling, expect stabilization in ~2 hours, will follow up. :thumbsup:
devbot: deploy v1.2.3 started for region us-east-1
ops-sre: patch applied to us-east-1. monitoring for 30m.
ops-sre: 15m in, no duplicates observed for repro-987 in us-east-1. :eyes:
mari: customer confirmed improved behavior on Dedicated instance. Closing once 24h validation passes.
